Koronaios — fetched 03 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons describes the mural in the Cathedral of Athens as St Hierotheus, Saint Hierotheos of Athens, the Thesmothete. Both the city and the epithet θεσμοθέτης — the Areopagite magistracy he held before Dionysius consecrated him — are in the description, and the city is this folder's. Commons describes it: Mural depicting St. Hierotheus (Saint Hierotheos of Athens) the Thesmothete at the Cathedral of Athens.
